tokens.name: bg-content
tokens.usage: The thread, diffs and tables: the surface you read. Darkest layer in dark, white in light.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Docked panels: the sidebar and the inspector. One step off bg-content.

tokens.name: bg-chrome
tokens.usage: Title bar and tab bar.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces only: menus, popovers, the phone sheet. Always with border and shadow-float.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered row or ghost control.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: The one selected row in a list. Selection is this fill and nothing else: no bar, no border.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panes, rows and table cells. Decorative, so it may sit below 3:1.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input and outlined button edges. At least 3:1 on bg-content, bg-panel and bg-chrome.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on every bg- token.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata: node, group, branch, times. Reads on every bg- token.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Line numbers, placeholders, separators. 4.5:1 on every bg- token including bg-selected.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: links, the focus ring, the primary action, inline code. Never decoration.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, 1px offset, on every focusable control.

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: Working: the spinner glyph and its word. Blue so it never relies on red versus green.

tokens.name: status-attention
tokens.usage: Needs input and ready to review: glyph and word.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Failed, expired login, blocked move: glyph and word, never a filled pill.

tokens.name: diff-add-bg
tokens.usage: Added line background in a diff, under text.

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: Removed line background in a diff, under text.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: The + marker and +N counts.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: The - marker and -N counts.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: a settings page title. Never in the conversation view.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Pane header titles and the conversation title.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Rows, buttons, inputs, menus: the default interface text.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Section labels inside panes, the selected tab.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata after a title, table headers.

styles.name: prose
styles.usage: Agent and user messages. Keep to size-measure wide.
styles.sample: The backups packages pin 0.31.2, so I bumped midden to the same version.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code only: tool calls, diffs, inline code and commands to copy. Never chrome metadata.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Diff line numbers and gutters only.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its word inside a status mark; between stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls; between a row's title and its meta.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Row inline padding (Zed's px_1p5).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control inline padding at size-control-md; gap between controls in a bar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pane inline padding; gap between thread blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between thread turns; dialog and sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a settings page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding of the thread.

size.note: Every height, width and icon in the system comes from here. A component never carries its own px value.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and tags inside rows and bars (Zed ButtonSize Default).

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, tab and one-line list row (Zed Medium, Paseo tight row).

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Composer controls, dialog actions (Zed Large).

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: One-line list rows, menu items, section heads and table header rows. Controls inside stay size-control-md.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target on touch clients: rows and controls grow to this, type does not.

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: Pane header and tab bar height.

tokens.name: size-difffile
tokens.usage: Diff file header strip (Paseo FILE_HEADER_HEIGHT).

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in size-control-sm and in meta text.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in size-control-md and lg.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: Status dot (Zed Indicator, Paseo dot).

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Default sidebar width; resizable.

tokens.name: size-inspector
tokens.usage: Default inspector width.

tokens.name: size-menu
tokens.usage: Popover menu width.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of thread content.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything docked: panes, rows in panels, tables, the composer strip, diff blocks.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags, a hovered or selected row inset in a menu.

tokens.name: radius-block
tokens.usage: Blocks inside the thread: the user message, a tool card, a code block.

tokens.name: radius-float
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces only: menus, popovers, the phone sheet's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The status dot and the switch thumb. Nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: bg-raised surfaces only. Nothing docked casts a shadow.
